question.en: Who made the only funny joke that evening and why?
question.zh: 那天晚上唯一可笑的笑话是谁讲的，为什么？

sentences.en: Who made the only funny joke that evening and why?
sentences.zh: 那天晚上唯一可笑的笑话是谁讲的，为什么？

sentences.en: People will do anything to see a free show -- even if it is a bad one.
sentences.zh: 人们为了看一场免费的演出什么都肯做——即使演出很糟糕。

chunks.x: even if it is a bad one

sentences.en: When the news got round that a comedy show would be presented
sentences.zh: 当消息传开，说一出喜剧将由

sentences.en: at our local cinema by the P.and U. Bird Seed Company, we all rushed to see it.
sentences.zh: P.U.鸟食公司在我们当地影院演出时，我们都跑去看了。

chunks.x: at our local cinema by the P.and U. Bird Seed Company
by the P.and U. Bird Seed Company

sentences.en: We had to queue for hours to get in and there must have been several hundred people present just before the show began.
sentences.zh: 我们排了几个小时的队才进去，演出开始前在场的人肯定有好几百。

sentences.en: Unfortunately, the show was one of the dullest we have ever seen.
sentences.zh: 不幸的是，这是我们所看过的最乏味的演出之一。

chunks.x: of the dullest we have ever seen

sentences.en: Those who failed to get in need not have felt disappointed,
sentences.zh: 没能进去的人本不必感到失望，

sentences.en: as many of the artistes who should have appeared did not come.
sentences.zh: 因为许多本该出场的艺人并没有来。

chunks.x: of the artistes who should have appeared

sentences.en: The only funny things we heard that evening came from the advertiser at the beginning of the programme.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上我们听到的唯一有趣的话，是节目开始时做广告的人说的。

chunks.x: at the beginning of the programme

sentences.en: He was obviously very nervous and for some minutes stood awkwardly before the microphone.
sentences.zh: 他显然非常紧张，在麦克风前局促不安地站了好几分钟。

sentences.en: As soon as he opened his mouth, everyone burst out laughing.
sentences.zh: 他一开口，大家就哄堂大笑。

chunks.x: As soon as he opened his mouth

sentences.en: We all know what the poor man should have said,
sentences.zh: 我们都知道这个可怜的人本该说什么，

chunks.x: what the poor man should have said

sentences.en: but what he actually said was: 'This is the Poo and Ee Seed Bird Company. Good ladies, evening and gentlemen!'
sentences.zh: 但他实际说的却是：“这是Poo and Ee 鸟食种子公司。好女士们，晚上好和先生们！”
